speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Master Shakespeare. I am in. The way was dry enough. I have the horses in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have one letter. Susanna's. It was written on the twenty-sixth. It goes now.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence the letter. I can carry it. I cannot make her read what you meant instead.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She can read this one. There is nothing else. No parcel, and no money beside it.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence, then. And I have nothing for you this time. No cheese, no glove, no word I was told to put in your hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing is a clear load. I will take the clear load.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then we are done. The letter is in the bag. God keep the house that gets it.
